title: BudgetBreakdown
description: The normative realization of the budget-observability MUST (Budgeting.md §6): which system-prompt sections were included, their token cost, and what was shed. Read-model behind a prompt-inspection surface and the loop live budget. Sensitive content MAY be omitted while this structure is retained. Normative.

sections.description: One entry per named system-prompt section (Budgeting.md §1), in composition order.

name.description: Section name, e.g. security, soul, workflow, backstory, context, preferences, memory, tools (Budgeting.md §1).

included.description: Whether the section entered the composed prompt. false means shed/omitted under budget pressure or per-persona policy.

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated token cost of the section as composed; 0 when not included. Counted with the active model's tokenizer_hint (Budgeting.md §2).

priority.description: Shed priority — lower is retained longer; pinned sections rank first. Makes the actual shed order (RECOMMENDED, §3) inspectable.

shed_reason.description: Why the section was shed/reduced, or null when included in full. e.g. over_budget, persona_policy, memory_cap.

total_estimated_tokens.description: Sum of included sections' estimated_tokens — the system-prompt allotment S actually consumed (Budgeting.md §2).

model_context_window.description: The active model's context window W (schema/model.json context_window, Budgeting.md §2), so cost is legible against capacity.
